authors: G. Arutyunov, S. Frolov, R. Suzuki
title: Five-loop Konishi from the Mirror TBA
claim: The AdS5 x S5 mirror TBA equations reproduce numerically the five-loop Konishi anomalous dimension obtained from the generalized Luscher formula - a test of the TBA system.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. Mirror thermodynamic Bethe ansatz.

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit
mirror TBA equations (string hypothesis for mirror bound states) describe excited states

red_flags: agreement between two integrability constructions is a consistency test of integrability, not a field-theory check
